clips.title: The story
paras: At Menethil Keep, Valstag Ironjaw helps guard the routes between Loch Modan and the coast. He keeps the garrison informed of dangers along the trade passages.

Valstag Ironjaw serves with the dwarven garrison inside Menethil Keep in Menethil Harbor. The marsh around the keep is dangerous, with Dragonmaw orcs and ravenous wildlife threatening communications and supplies. Valstag helps coordinate defenses along the main roads, especially the perilous passage through Dun Algaz toward Loch Modan.

Hostile forces crowd the Algaz Gauntlet, putting travelers and supply convoys between Menethil Harbor and Loch Modan at risk. Valstag sends capable adventurers against the brigands and orcs in the passes. He carries military reports between forward scouts and commanders such as Captain Stoutfist.
